thread:
Maya: Quick batch from onboarding calls this week — 18 signal items (feature asks / pain points). Condensed inbox for triage. TL;DR: most ask about per-route cost visibility, 2x embedding freshness, 1x exportable onboarding checklist, 1x SSO mapping bug blocking login. CSV attached in thread.
Priya: Thanks Maya — can you paste top 5 by urgency here?
Maya: Top 5 (flagged by CS):
- P0: SSO mapping / Acme Retail renewal blocker (login mismatch on idp attributes)
- P1: Per-route cost breakdown in Console (customers want CSV export + per-route drilldown)
- P1: Exportable onboarding checklist template (enablement request)
- P2: Embedding freshness/staleness warning on batch jobs (two customers)
- P3: Better default quotas + clearer error for rate limiting during onboarding
Priya: Nice, that helps. @Jonas any quick thoughts on P0/P1?
Jonas: I can take per-route cost + embedding freshness. P0 SSO mapping looks like an engineering config bug — need logs from the customer.
Jonas: For per-route cost, want a short spike to define signals: token counters per route, route metadata, and export format. I'll open a spike ticket. :+1:
Maya: Copy — I exported the call notes and attached sample CSV. Here's a small snippet:```customer_id,issue,flag,notes
acme-001,SSO mapping,P0,login failing: claim 'email' vs 'mail' mismatch
parkco-23,per-route-cost,P1,wants per-route CSV and daily export
brightlane-7,embed-freshness,P2,observed 48h lag on embeddings pipeline
```
Ava: I can run a quick cohort count — how many customers mentioned per-route cost this quarter? Give me an hour and I'll post numbers + a simple dashboard query.
Liam: For the exportable checklist, we should create a lightweight template in the onboarding repo and add a link in the Help Center. I can own the doc + small content PR. ETA next Wed.
Priya: SSO mapping: Maya please share the IdP logs and the user mapping table for Acme. If it's blocking renewal, we escalate to SRE/engineering and set a 48-hour SLA.
Maya: Shared logs to #eng-runtime and tagged @jonas and @eng-oncall. Also marked the CSV with a 'blocking_renewal' column.
pulse-bot: New ticket created PROD-1429: "SSO mapping mismatch for acme-001" assigned to Jonas.
Jonas: Got it. I'll do a fast follow and create a short reproduction script. Will update PROD-1429 with steps.
Priya: Can we also add a simple priority rubric to the intake row: "blocking_renewal", "business_impact", "#customers_affected"? That will help CS <> PM syncs.
Ava: I'll add a column and compute #customers_affected across last 6 months. Posting numbers by EOD.
Maya: I'll consolidate everything into the product intake doc and link PROD-1429 + Liam's checklist PR. Sending summary to the weekly triage board. Thanks all :heart:
